items.title: iii. Reaction with sodium metal (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: iii. Reaction with sodium metal: a main subheading of 22.4 Reactions of Alcohols, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 92-92.

blocks.text: Jab alcohol sodium (Na) jaisi reactive metal se react karta hai to hydroxyl group ka oxygen-hydrogen bond toot jata hai. Yeh reaction sodium aur paani ke reaction se kam tez hai, phir bhi hydrogen gas nikalti hai aur ek base (alkoxide) banta hai. Is reaction ko hydroxy (-OH) group ke test ke liye use kar sakte hain: agar -OH group maujood ho to hydrogen gas ke bulbule nikalte hain. Reaction ke baad bacha hua (excess) ethanol uda dein to sodium alkoxide ka white (safaid) crystalline solid bachta hai. Alcohol ki hydrocarbon chain jitni lambi ho, reaction utna hi kam tez hota hai.

blocks.alt: Sheeshe ka conical flask jis par 250, 200, 150, 100 ke nishan hain; is mein ethanol aur phenolphthalein ka shaffaf solution hai, aur pende (bottom) par jahan sodium react kar raha hai wahan pink rang ban raha hai.
blocks.caption: Phenolphthalein aur ethanol ke solution mein sodium dalne par pink colour dheere dheere aata hai. Paani mein pink colour foran aa jata hai. Is se pata chalta hai ke Na ka ethanol se reaction paani ke muqable mein aahista hai (kitab ki chhapi tasveer ke mutabiq original drawing).
